content.text: I’ll trace comment deletion, issue archiving, search indexing, and the per-workspace rebuild, then update the relevant code paths.

input.command: /bin/zsh -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!**/.next/**'"' | head -100 && rg -n \"search|archiv|deletedAt|deleted|commentCount|comments\" src app prisma"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' src/server/services/search-service.ts && sed -n '1,230p' src/server/repositories/search-repository.ts && sed -n '1,240p' src/server/jobs/search-reindex-job.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/server/repositories/comment-repository.ts && sed -n '180,270p' src/server/services/issue-service.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,210p' src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts && sed -n '1,150p' src/server/repositories/project-repository.ts && sed -n '1,120p' src/server/repositories/_paging.ts && sed -n '1,100p' src/server/db/schema/comments.ts && sed -n '1,140p' src/server/jobs/types.ts && sed -n '1,170p' src/server/jobs/cleanup-archived-job.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "cat src/schemas/comment.ts && cat src/schemas/project.ts | head -110 && cat src/schemas/issue.ts | grep -A45 'issueFilterSchema' && sed -n '1,150p' src/server/db/schema/search-index.ts && sed -n '1,90p' src/server/db/schema/index.ts"

content.text: I found the main gaps: comment deletion removes an issue document by mistake, issue archive only removes the issue document, and rebuild reads just the first page while including archived rows. I’m adding tenant-scoped cleanup and paging through live rows for the rebuild.
